hypothesis_generation.reference_vote: Each query contributes its semantic-local fusion top-one winning target reference. Select the majority reference; break ties by deterministic sorted reference order.

hypothesis_generation.truth_boundary: No target box, IoU, target mask or target coverage enters reference voting, candidate generation, candidate ranking or deduplication. Truth is opened only for evaluation.
